targets.authors: Miller S. L., Maner J. K.
targets.title: Sick body, vigilant mind: The biological immune system activates the behavioral immune system.
targets.evidence_quote: The current study directly replicated Study 1 of Miller and Maner (2011) to test the robustness of the effect of illness recency on attention to pathogen cues.
targets.outcome_quote: No effect of illness recency on attentional bias for disfigured faces emerged. Though it did not support the original finding, this replication provides suggestions for future research on the psychological underpinnings of pathogen avoidance.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The overall verdict rejects the original central illness-recency interaction. Cautions about the broader immunological hypothesis do not declare this attempt incapable of adjudicating its specific target.

reasoning: Direct new-sample replication of Study 1, rather than the other background studies or the paper supplying stimuli.
